project: Opsly - Multi-tenant SaaS (n8n, Stripe, AI Agents)
analysis_scope: Strategic skill gaps that would add 10%+ operational value

gaps.why_needed: opsly-economist exists but lacks predictive analytics for multi-tenant scenarios. Platform has 13 library modules, Stripe billing, Redis/BullMQ costs, and variable LLM pricing (Anthropic, others). Current economist is reactive; forecasting would enable proactive plan adjustments and prevent budget overruns per tenant.
gaps.impact: Prevent surprise bills; optimize plan recommendations; reduce churn from over-billed tenants. 15-20% savings potential in infra/LLM costs.
gaps.operational_gap: No predictive model for: LLM token burn by tenant type, seasonal spikes, multi-provider fallback cost deltas, or ROI of feature flags (e.g., NotebookLM experimental).
gaps.users_affected: Admin dashboard, Operations (cost governance), Finance (invoice accuracy)

gaps.capability_name: Multi-Tenant Data Audit & PII/Compliance Risk Scanning
gaps.why_needed: Platform has 13+ library modules including @intcloudsysops/security (encryption, PII redaction) and multi-tenant Postgres isolation. No centralized skill for auditing tenant data flows, detecting unredacted PII in logs, or validating GDPR/CCPA compliance across schemas. Critical for enterprise sales.
gaps.impact: Enable compliance certifications (SOC2, GDPR); reduce legal risk; unblock enterprise customers. ~20-30% revenue increase from enterprise TAM.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: automated PII scanner on logs/backups, audit trail generator, policy validator, tenant data lineage mapper, breach simulation (tabletop exercises).
gaps.users_affected: Compliance officer, Sales (enterprise), Security team, Ops (legal holds)

gaps.why_needed: Platform has @intcloudsysops/observability module but no OpenTelemetry integration. 18+ microservices (api, admin, portal, mcp, llm-gateway, orchestrator, context-builder, local-services, etc.) with BullMQ queues and n8n tenant stacks. Current logging is scattered; tracing tenant requests end-to-end is impossible. ADR-019 (Prometheus/Grafana) exists but no implementation guidance.
gaps.impact: Reduce MTTR by 50%; identify performance bottlenecks; trace cost per tenant operation; enable SLA monitoring for enterprise plans.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: OTel instrumentation for orchestrator job lifecycle, LLM latency tracking, Traefik routing hops, tenant isolation violations detection, cost attribution per trace.
gaps.users_affected: DevOps, SRE, Product (performance metrics), Enterprise support

gaps.why_needed: Platform uses Docker Compose per tenant with manual port allocation (@intcloudsysops/config manages feature flags). No dynamic sizing: n8n/Uptime Kuma CPU/RAM are static. As tenant count grows (roadmap shows 50-100 SMBs target), VPS will become bottleneck. Need to auto-scale based on usage patterns, predict when to provision new VPS, and rebalance tenants across hosts.
gaps.impact: Enable hypergrowth phase (50-100 tenants on single VPS → multi-VPS cluster). Prevent 503 outages during peaks. ~$5k-15k annual infra savings from right-sizing.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: usage-based sizing recommendation engine, tenant rebalancing orchestrator, multi-VPS load balancer, cold tenant deprovision, burst capacity predictor.

gaps.why_needed: Platform has orchestrator and BullMQ but no auto-remediation for common failures: tenant health checks, Redis OOM, Postgres connection pool exhaustion, Stripe webhook retry logic, orphaned Docker containers, TLS cert rotation. Current approach is manual ops runbooks.
gaps.impact: Reduce on-call burden by 60%; prevent cascading failures; improve SLA uptime from ~95% to 99.5%+. Enable 24/7 autonomous operations.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: circuit breaker orchestration, auto-restart policies, database connection pooler tuning, Traefik backend health auto-remediation, tenant resource limit enforcement.

gaps.capability_name: Advanced ML Observability & Model Drift Detection
gaps.why_needed: Apps/ml exists, opsly-feedback-ml exists, but no integrated ML monitoring. LLM Gateway routes to Anthropic/others; no tracking of model output quality over time, token waste from hallucinations, or automatic fallback to cheaper models. opsly-feedback-ml covers feedback loops but lacks drift detection on inference patterns.
gaps.impact: Reduce LLM token waste by 20-30%; detect degradation before customers notice; enable A/B testing of model providers. Critical for LLM cost governance.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: LLM output quality scorer, token efficiency tracker, model inference latency SLO setter, automatic provider fallback orchestrator, prompt version control with A/B analytics.
gaps.users_affected: ML engineer, LLM Gateway owner, Product (model selection)

gaps.capability_name: Tenant Data Backup & Disaster Recovery Automation
gaps.why_needed: Scripts/backup-tenants.sh exists (mentioned in README) but no skill. Backup strategy relies on cron + manual `restore-tenant.sh`. No RTO/RPO SLAs, no cross-region replication, no backup integrity validation, no rollback testing. Enterprise customers will demand guaranteed recovery.
gaps.impact: Enable enterprise SLA contracts; reduce data loss risk from regional outage; prove compliance with audit logs. 5-10% enterprise deals blocked without this.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: backup scheduler with SLA monitoring, cross-region replication orchestrator, automated restore testing, backup integrity validator, point-in-time recovery UI, disaster recovery playbook generator.
gaps.users_affected: Backup admin, Enterprise support, Compliance, Customers (critical data)

gaps.capability_name: Tenant Secret Rotation & Encryption Key Management
gaps.why_needed: Platform uses Doppler for control-plane secrets but tenant-level secrets (n8n API keys, webhook tokens, integrations) are static. No rotation policy, no key versioning, no encryption key escrow. ADR-003 covers Doppler but doesn't address multi-tenant secret lifecycle.
gaps.impact: Reduce security incident severity; comply with NIST rotation requirements; enable tenant self-service secret management. Required for SOC2/ISO27001.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: tenant secret vault interface, automatic rotation scheduler, key versioning with rollback, encryption key escrow agent, audit trail for secret access.
gaps.users_affected: Security officer, Tenant admins, Ops (secret audit)

gaps.capability_name: Advanced Orchestrator Job Debugging & Execution Replay
gaps.why_needed: Orchestrator (apps/orchestrator) manages BullMQ jobs with OAR (Opsly Agentic Runtime) lifecycle. opsly-orchestrator skill exists but no job debugging tools: no step-by-step replay, no variable inspection, no conditional breakpoints. Hard to diagnose why a job failed or to replay a failed workflow.
gaps.impact: Reduce MTTR for job failures from hours to minutes; enable power users to self-debug; reduce support tickets by 30%.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: interactive job replay engine, execution graph visualizer, variable snapshot at each step, conditional breakpoint setter, replay-with-different-inputs tool.

gaps.capability_name: Tenant Onboarding Automation & Welcome Experience Engine
gaps.why_needed: opsly-tenant skill covers onboarding mechanics, but no skill for multi-step onboarding workflows: sending tutorial videos, configuring example n8n workflows, setting up Slack/Discord integration, scheduling first sync, gathering feedback. Current onboarding is manual or script-based.
gaps.impact: Reduce onboarding time from days to hours; improve CSAT by 25%; enable self-serve activation. Boost activation rate from ~70% to 95%+.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: onboarding orchestrator (n8n template mixer), video tutorial dispatcher, example workflow seeder, feedback collector, first-use success tracker, churn predictor.
gaps.users_affected: Customer success, Sales, Tenant admins, New users

gaps.why_needed: Platform has Stripe billing and plans (Startup/Business/Enterprise) but enforcement is post-hoc: quotas on n8n execution count, API rate limits, storage per tenant are not enforced in real-time. Tenants can exceed soft limits without immediate feedback.
gaps.impact: Reduce billing disputes; prevent runaway usage from breaking margin; enable dynamic tier upsells. 5-10% revenue uplift from quota monetization.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: per-tenant quota enforcer (goroutine-based metering), overage auto-notification, dynamic rate limiter per plan, quota upgrade suggester, usage dashboard with forecast.

gaps.why_needed: Platform has 1 real tenant (smiletripcare). As it grows, no skill to: suggest next features based on cohort usage, benchmark tenant performance against peers (anonymized), identify best-practice workflows, or auto-recommend upgrades based on usage trajectory.
gaps.impact: Enable product-led growth (PLG); reduce churn by surfacing value; drive upsells through benchmarking. 20% increase in ASP from upsells.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: cross-tenant anonymized benchmarking aggregator, feature-usage analyzer per tenant cohort, upgrade recommendation engine, best-practice template suggester.

gaps.why_needed: Monorepo has 13+ library modules (@intcloudsysops/*) and ~50 npm packages. No unified skill for: dependency update orchestration, CVE scanning per app, license compliance checking, or automated patch testing. Current approach is scattered npm audit checks.
gaps.impact: Reduce security incident risk from vulnerable deps; automate patch management; ensure license compliance. Prevent supply chain attacks.
gaps.operational_gap: Missing: monorepo-wide SCA (software composition analysis) with policy enforcement, automated PR generator for security patches, dependency tree visualizer, license scanner with approval workflows.

critical.rationale: Enable enterprise sales, security compliance, and operational visibility. Blocking factors for 50-100 tenant scale.

high.rationale: Required for 99.5% SLA, enterprise contracts, and scalability. Reduce on-call burden and churn.

medium.rationale: Improve DX, PLG efficiency, and security posture. Medium ROI but high user satisfaction.

phase_1_immediate.success_metric: Enterprise RFP response time < 24h; cost forecasting accuracy > 90%

phase_2_scaling.success_metric: 99.5% platform uptime; zero SLA breaches; SOC2 readiness

phase_4_hardening.success_metric: Zero critical CVEs; token efficiency > 15% improvement; secret audit 100% coverage

adoption_strategy.for_claude: Load skills via skill-finder.js. Route Cost/Compliance/Tracing queries through auto-loaded chains.
adoption_strategy.for_cursor: Pre-wire skills in .cursor/prompts and .cursor/rules. Integrate opsly-job-debugger into development loop.
adoption_strategy.for_external_agents: Export via npm run skills:sync:external to /mnt/skills/. Hermes/OpenCode consume the same manifests.
adoption_strategy.for_ci_cd: Add validation steps in GitHub Actions: skill-validator, dependency-scanner, compliance-auditor pre-merge.

cost_governance: Tenant LLM cost per operation down 20%
scalability: Support 100+ tenants on single VPS cluster

risk_mitigation.skill_overlap_with_existing: Audit dependencies to avoid reimplementing opsly-economist, opsly-orchestrator, etc. Use composition, not duplication.
risk_mitigation.performance_impact: Distributed tracing adds ~5-10% latency per service. Recommend async collectors and sampling policies (10% of traces).
risk_mitigation.security_of_new_endpoints: All new skills handling secrets/audit/compliance require admin bearer + RLS validation. Pre-audit with opsly-architect-senior.
risk_mitigation.third_party_vendor_lock_in: Prefer open standards (OpenTelemetry, Stripe REST API) over proprietary agents. Validate exit paths.
risk_mitigation.maintenance_burden: Skills with external deps (Temporal, Vault, Trivy) need version pinning and upgrade scripts in CI.

quick_wins_immediate_roi.win: Add cost forecast to admin dashboard
quick_wins_immediate_roi.roi: Prevent surprise bills; sell to 2-3 enterprise prospects.

quick_wins_immediate_roi.win: Integrate Anthropic token counter into LLM Gateway

conclusion.summary: Opsly has strong foundational skills (31 total) but lacks 13 critical capabilities for enterprise scale. Largest gaps: predictive cost modeling, compliance auditing, distributed tracing, auto-scaling, and self-healing. Together, these skills unlock $20k+ MRR from enterprise TAM and reduce operations burden by 60%.
conclusion.next_step: Prioritize cost-forecaster, compliance-auditor, and distributed-tracing in Phase 1. These three unblock enterprise sales and operational visibility.
